en.title: Show HN: We Built the Smallest Dual-Band Aircraft Tracker
en.hook: An ultra-compact embedded hardware project implementing simultaneous 1090MHz and 978MHz ADS-B aircraft tracking.
key_takeaways: Simultaneous reception of 1090MHz ES and 978MHz UAT signals in a miniature form factor.
Extremely optimized size and power consumption tailored for small drones and portable avionics.
Custom RF circuit engineering combined with efficient embedded signal processing.

zh.title: Show HN：我们打造了全球最小的双频飞机追踪器
zh.hook: 采用超小型嵌入式硬件设计，实现 1090MHz 与 978MHz 双频 ADS-B 航空器实时追踪。
key_takeaways: 在微型尺寸内同时支持 1090MHz ES 与 978MHz UAT 信号接收
针对小型无人机及便携式设备进行了极佳的尺寸与功耗优化
集成了自研 RF 电路设计与高效的嵌入式信号处理算法
